verdict.rationale: The evidence documents consent and opt-out controls that mParticle customers apply to their own end users' data, such as Data Privacy Controls, CCPA data-sale opt-out forwarding rules, and Consent Filters. Nothing shows that a user of mParticle can opt out of mParticle's own telemetry or usage tracking. Those end-user consent features are an adjacent capability and earn no credit for this story.
